# ThinkAI

> ThinkAI is an AI growth studio for service businesses. It combines human strategy, creative direction, and AI-powered automation into one connected system covering marketing, sales, and operations — rather than selling AI as a standalone product.

ThinkAI is human-led: strategy, judgment, and creative direction come from people; AI is used to execute at scale (phone and chat agents, marketing automation, sales follow-up, business-process automation). The company is based in Port Richey, Florida, and works with service businesses across the US, remotely.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.thinkai.team/services/): All 8 services and how they connect into one growth system.
- [AI Phone Agents](https://www.thinkai.team/services/ai-phone-agents/): AI-handled inbound/outbound phone calls — answering, qualifying, booking, with human escalation for exceptions.
- [AI Chat & Messaging Agents](https://www.thinkai.team/services/ai-chat-messaging-agents/): AI-handled chat and messaging conversations across web, SMS, and social channels.
- [Marketing & Growth Strategy](https://www.thinkai.team/services/marketing-growth-strategy/): Positioning, channel strategy, and growth planning grounded in the business, not templates.
- [Paid Advertising](https://www.thinkai.team/services/paid-advertising/): Paid ad campaign strategy and management across search and social platforms.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.thinkai.team/services/social-media-management/): Content strategy and production combining human creative direction with AI-assisted production.
- [Website Development](https://www.thinkai.team/services/website-development/): Custom website design and development for service businesses.
- [Sales Automation](https://www.thinkai.team/services/sales-automation/): Automated lead follow-up, CRM workflows, and sales-process automation.
- [Business Systems & Process Automation](https://www.thinkai.team/services/business-systems/): Internal workflow and operations automation beyond sales and marketing.
